publication.prior_report_citation: Infevers database (56) (https://infevers.umai-montpellier.fr/): "Functional information of already published TNFAIP3 mutations from HA20 families can be obtained from the Infevers database"; ref 56: Van Gijn M. E. et al., J. Med. Genet. 55, 530-537 (2018). No specific earlier report of these patients is cited

individuals.treatment_summary: TNF antagonist infliximab; on treatment her B cell repertoire richness, diversity and IGHV4-34 usage normalized to levels of healthy individuals

variants.functional_evidence_statement: Before treatment initiation the patient showed classical A20 deficiency with constitutive NF-kB activation (Fig. 3A: immunoblotting of A20 and NF-kB status in PBMCs; NF-kB activation assessed by nuclear translocation of p65) and excessive proinflammatory cytokine elevations, especially TNF (Fig. 3B)

phenotypic_features.feature_text_as_stated: excessive proinflammatory cytokine elevations, especially TNF
phenotypic_features.severity_or_detail: before treatment initiation; plasma cytokine levels at initial presentation (day 0) vs six healthy donors (Fig. 3B)
phenotypic_features.hpo_label_candidate: Elevated circulating tumor necrosis factor alpha level

variants.pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors: not classified; described as a second genetic hit found in lymphoma (DLBCL) tissue, acquired in addition to the germline TNFAIP3 mutation (somatic)
not classified; described as a second genetic hit found in lymphoma (DLBCL) tissue (somatic)

phenotypic_features.severity_or_detail: diagnosed in the course of his disease; lymphoma tissue carried an additional TNFAIP3 c.1880_1881delGT (p.Cys627fs) and an MYD88 c.617C > G (p.Ser206Cys) mutation; malignant clone expressed IGHV3-23 with about 81% identity to germline
